sentences.en: Everyone ought to be a master of his own destiny.
sentences.zh: 每个人都应该掌握自己的命运。

sentences.en: It is the character that seals the destiny of everyone.
sentences.zh: 是性格决定了每个人的命运。

sentences.en: Do you believe our destinies are controlled by the stars?
sentences.zh: 你相信我们的命运由星辰掌控吗？

senses.zh: 命运,天命，天数,命运的三女神,主宰事物的力量
